transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because my sleep has gotten completely out of control. At first I’d sleep maybe two or three hours, then be up making plans and feeling like I was ready to go. Now it’s different—I’m awake before dawn, my stomach feels tight, and I don’t feel rested at all.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure I’d call it depressed most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve been feeling off, definitely, but I haven’t been tracking it that way.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually upbeat, irritable, or energetic, even if just for a few days?

Yes. For weeks I felt almost… brilliantly optimistic, like every problem was small and I could handle anything. But I was also very quick to get irritated. If someone questioned me, I’d snap at them, like they were trying to get in my way or undermine me.
After those periods of feeling very upbeat or energetic, have you had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yes. After all those plans fell apart, I went into a low place. I felt guilty and pulled away from people, and it’s been going on for about nine months now.
